author: Ali (team lead)

connection.port_note: Port 5433 is NOT publicly reachable — GCP firewall blocks it. You must SSH into the VM first.

ssh_access.method: GCP OS Login — SSH is tied to your Google account, no key management needed
ssh_access.username_format: Replace '@' and '.' in your Gmail with '_' (e.g. john.doe@gmail.com → john_doe_gmail_com)

psql_commands.interactive_shell: docker exec -it innovacx-db psql -U innovacx_user -d complaints_db
psql_commands.run_sql_file: docker exec -i innovacx-db psql -U innovacx_user -d complaints_db -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < path/to/file.sql
psql_commands.run_one_liner: docker exec innovacx-db psql -U innovacx_user -d complaints_db -c "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tickets;"
psql_commands.check_ticket_counts: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM tickets GROUP BY status ORDER BY COUNT DESC;
psql_commands.backup: docker exec innovacx-db pg_dump -U innovacx_user complaints_db > backup_$(date +%Y%m%d).sql
psql_commands.restore_WARNING_destroys_data: docker exec -i innovacx-db psql -U innovacx_user -d complaints_db < backup_file.sql

docker_notes.postgres_data_volume: Named Docker volume 'innova-cx_postgres_data'. Persists across restarts.
docker_notes.fresh_db_warning: To reset to a clean DB: docker volume rm innova-cx_postgres_data then docker compose up --build. THIS DESTROYS ALL DATA.
docker_notes.restart_vs_recreate: docker compose restart does NOT reload .env. Use: docker compose up -d --force-recreate innovacx-db

db_init_on_fresh_volume.description: On a fresh volume Docker auto-runs all files in database/ alphabetically via docker-entrypoint-initdb.d. Order is critical.

execution_order.description: Core schema, enums, triggers, SLA logic, recurrence classifier, seed data. NEVER insert into ML tables here.
Extra seed rows for core tables only. NEVER insert into ML tables here.
Shell script that runs the 3 SQL steps below in order, then refreshes all MVs.
Comprehensive seed for all 37 tables, including ML pipeline data. Final refresh call included.

zzz_analytics_mvs_sh_steps: Step 2: database/scripts/000_analytics_prerequisites.sql — creates 6 agent output tables + additive columns
Step 3: database/scripts/analytics_mvs.sql — creates 8 analytics materialized views + refresh function
Step 4: SELECT refresh_analytics_mvs() — populates all MVs with seed data
db_init_on_fresh_volume.critical_warning: Subdirectories (migrations/, scripts/) are NOT auto-run by Docker directly. Only the shell script at database/ root runs them. NEVER add ML table inserts to init.sql or seed_extra.sql — those tables do not exist yet at that point, causing the entire transaction to roll back and leaving the DB empty.

applying_migrations_to_existing_volume.description: The VM postgres_data volume already exists — Docker will NOT re-run init scripts. Apply manually in this order:

steps.command: docker exec -i innovacx-db psql -U innovacx_user -d complaints_db -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < database/migrations/001_agent_execution_logs.sql
steps.description: Creates model_execution_log + agent_output_log + 6 agent output tables

steps.command: docker exec -i innovacx-db psql -U innovacx_user -d complaints_db -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < database/scripts/000_analytics_prerequisites.sql
steps.description: Adds additive columns, ensures agent output tables exist

steps.command: docker exec -i innovacx-db psql -U innovacx_user -d complaints_db -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < database/scripts/analytics_mvs.sql
steps.description: Creates all 8 materialized views + refresh function

steps.command: docker exec -i innovacx-db psql -U innovacx_user -d complaints_db -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < database/migrations/002_operator_notifications.sql
docker exec -i innovacx-db psql -U innovacx_user -d complaints_db -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < database/migrations/003_routing_review_queue.sql
docker exec innovacx-db psql -U innovacx_user -d complaints_db -c "SELECT refresh_analytics_mvs();"

applying_migrations_to_existing_volume.idempotency: All scripts use IF NOT EXISTS / OR REPLACE. Safe to re-run — they will be a no-op on already-applied changes.

schema.analytics_schema_warning: The 'analytics' schema does NOT exist on prod-live. All materialized views are in the 'public' schema. Do not reference analytics.* in any SQL targeting the VM.

core_identity_tables.description: One-to-one extension of users with personal/professional details.
Reference table for departments. Name is unique.

ticket_tables.description: Central table. Every complaint or inquiry submitted.
triggers: trg_tickets_updated_at — sets updated_at on every UPDATE
trg_tickets_status_timestamps — keeps assigned_at, resolved_at, resolved_by_user_id in sync
trg_tickets_priority_sla — auto-computes respond_due_at / resolve_due_at when priority changes

ticket_tables.description: Tickets where AI routing confidence was below threshold; awaiting manual department assignment.

sla_logic.description: SLA deadlines are computed automatically by the trg_tickets_priority_sla trigger when priority changes.
sla_logic.apply_ticket_sla_policies_function: Callable SQL function that: (1) heartbeats SLA countdown columns, (2) auto-escalates tickets at 90% of response SLA elapsed with no first_response_at, (3) marks tickets Overdue when SLA deadline passes. Call via: SELECT apply_ticket_sla_policies();

ml_logging_tables.description: One row per agent step per pipeline execution. Used by analytics MVs for Model Health.
Full JSON capture of each agent's input/output/state diff per execution step.

ml_agent_output_tables.description: One table per ML pipeline agent. Each row has is_current=TRUE for the latest result per ticket. A trigger (enforce_single_current_output) automatically flips older rows to is_current=FALSE when a new one is inserted.

analytics_materialized_views.description: 8 materialized views in the public schema. All created by database/scripts/analytics_mvs.sql.

dependency_order.description: Base enriched ticket rows — all other MVs that need ticket data build from this.
Daily ticket counts by status and priority.
Daily chatbot usage and escalation metrics.

operator_notification_triggers.description: DB-level triggers (migration 002) that auto-insert notifications for all active operators when system events occur.
operator_notification_triggers.helper_function: notify_all_operators(type, title, message, priority?, ticket_id?) — inserts one notification row per active operator

triggers.condition: Rolling last-20 acceptance rate drops below 70%
More than 50% of last 10 sessions were escalated to human
Rolling average model confidence across last 10 tickets drops below 65%
Unassigned ticket count reaches or exceeds 10
Any Critical+Unassigned ticket is older than 15 minutes. Deduplicates: max one alert per ticket per hour.
SLA breach rate in last 24 hours exceeds 30%
More than 10 tickets created in last 2 hours. Deduplicates: max once per hour.
is_active flips from TRUE to FALSE
Reset requested for employee/manager/operator roles only
Request still Pending after 24 hours. Deduplicates: max once per 24h per request.

migration_files.description: Creates model_execution_log, agent_output_log, and all 6 agent-specific output tables. Also adds model_version and confidence_at_time columns to ticket_resolution_feedback. Defines enforce_single_current_output trigger on all 6 output tables.
Creates all 15 operator notification triggers. Wrapped in BEGIN/COMMIT.
Creates routing_review_queue table and its indexes.

critical_rules: NEVER put ML table inserts in init.sql or seed_extra.sql. Those tables do not exist yet when those files run. ML inserts go in zzz_seedV2.sql ONLY.
New migrations go in database/migrations/ as 00N_name.sql and must be manually applied to the VM (Docker will not re-run them on an existing volume).
All migration scripts must be idempotent — use IF NOT EXISTS, OR REPLACE, DO $$ ... EXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_object. The VM volume is live data.
The 'analytics' schema does NOT exist on prod-live. All MVs are in the 'public' schema. Do not reference analytics.* in any SQL targeting the VM.
Port 5433 (postgres) is not internet-exposed. You cannot connect from your laptop. SSH to VM first.
postgres_data is a named Docker volume. It persists across container restarts and docker compose up. Only docker volume rm destroys it.
Never commit directly to main or prod-live. All work goes to a feature branch → PR to dev → verify end-to-end → merge to main → sync to prod-live via merge script.
prod-live never merges back to main. It is a one-way sync only.

branch_strategy.dev: Integration testing — ALL PRs merge here first. Verify end-to-end before touching main.
branch_strategy.main: Stable baseline — merge from dev only after dev is verified clean.
branch_strategy.prod-live: Live production — synced from main only via scripts/merge-main-into-prod-live.sh. Connected to real DB and real ML models. NEVER commit here directly.
branch_strategy.prod: Cloud testing and ML training runs.
branch_strategy.prod_live_sync_command: git checkout prod-live && git pull && git fetch origin main:main && ./scripts/merge-main-into-prod-live.sh && git push origin prod-live
branch_strategy.vm_deploy_after_push: cd /opt/innova-cx && git pull && docker compose --profile dev up --build -d
